title: mcp-atlassian arbitrary file read via confluence_upload_attachment path
summary: mcp-atlassian (PyPI) before 0.22.0: confluence_upload_attachment passes file_path directly to open(file_path, 'rb') with no path validation. Any authenticated MCP client — or a prompt-injected agent — can read any file the server process can access and exfiltrate it to Confluence as an attachment. Fixed in 0.22.0.
